verdict.rationale: Snowflake ships AI agent features (Cortex Agents, Snowflake CoCo), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents the server role: a Snowflake-managed MCP server that exposes Cortex Analyst, Search, Agents, custom tools and SQL to external agents. That evidence belongs to a different story and does not transfer. Nothing in the pack shows Snowflake connecting to or consuming tools from external MCP servers.
